title: Lunch Choices at Work
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的原创模拟听力材料（非雅思真题）。先听录音，注意much/many/a little/a few和should/should not的用法。然后完成8道听力题。之后学习语法规则并做8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目答案均来自录音或语法规则。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. It's 12:30. Time for lunch! Do you want to eat in the office kitchen or go out?
Ben: Let's go out. I have too many sandwiches in my bag. I need a hot meal.
Mia: OK. There is a new noodle shop next to the bank. It's cheap and fast.
Ben: Good idea. But I have only a little time today. I have a meeting at 1:30.
Mia: Me too. So we should not go to a big restaurant. We should choose a small place.
Ben: Right. How much money do you have? I have only a few dollars in my wallet.
Mia: I have enough. The noodle shop is only five dollars for a big bowl.
Ben: Perfect. I should not eat too much bread. I want noodles with vegetables.
Mia: Good. You should eat some vegetables every day. They are healthy.
Ben: Yes. And I should drink more water, not cola.
Mia: True. I have a little cola in my bottle, but I want tea.
Ben: Let's go. We have a few minutes before the meeting.
Mia: Wait. How many people are in the shop now? It looks busy.
Ben: I see only a few people. We can find a table.
Mia: Great. I should not be late for the meeting. Let's hurry.

grammar.title: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not
grammar.explanation: much用于不可数名词（如money, time, water），many用于可数名词复数（如sandwiches, people, dollars）。a little用于不可数名词，表示“一点”；a few用于可数名词复数，表示“几个”。should表示“应该”，should not表示“不应该”，后接动词原形。
grammar.example: I have only a little time today. I have only a few dollars in my wallet. We should not go to a big restaurant.

questions.prompt: I have only ______ time before the bus leaves.
questions.explanation: time是不可数名词，所以用a little。
questions.evidence: I have only a little time today.

questions.prompt: There are ______ apples on the table.
questions.explanation: apples是可数名词复数，所以用a few。
questions.evidence: I see only a few people.
How much money do you have?

questions.prompt: How ______ people are in the room?
questions.explanation: people是可数名词复数，所以用many。
questions.evidence: How many people are in the shop now?

questions.prompt: You ______ eat too much sugar. It is not good for you.
questions.evidence: I should not eat too much bread.

questions.prompt: We ______ drink more water every day.
questions.evidence: You should eat some vegetables every day.

questions.prompt: I have ______ water in my bottle. Let's share it.
questions.explanation: water是不可数名词，所以用a little。
questions.evidence: I have a little cola in my bottle.

questions.prompt: There are ______ chairs in the office. We can sit down.
questions.explanation: chairs是可数名词复数，所以用a few。
questions.evidence: I see only a few people.
